summary: BioCardia filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 disclosing a press release dated November 6, 2026, announcing completion of its clinical consultation process with Japan's Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency (PMDA) regarding application materials for the CardiAMP Cell Therapy System for ischemic heart failure. No terms, stake, price, or board recommendation are stated. The filing is an operational/regulatory milestone update, not a special situation. What to watch is the timing and outcome of the Japanese marketing approval submission, not an event-driven arbitrage angle.
